kjv: Blessed be he of the LORD, who hath not left off his kindness
mine: May he be blessed by Yahweh, whose steadfast love has not forsaken the living or the dead
note: 'asher lo'-'azav chasdo could refer to Boaz or to Yahweh as the one whose loyalty endures. Readers have long debated which is meant.
go'el is a technical term for a kinsman-redeemer with legal duties (land redemption, levirate). "Next kinsman" loses the institution that chs. 3-4 depend on.
